title: Reuse existing repository behavior
why: A newly added function repeats an unchanged production function instead of reusing the existing implementation.
suggestion: Call or extend the existing implementation when both functions represent the same behavior.
limitations: Requires a newly added one-line function with a non-trivial body matching an unchanged one-line production function after parameter normalization.
Intentional source-flavor variants and equivalent multiline implementations are not inferred.
Runs only for focused changes touching at most five production source files.
